site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Shaka abafasha bizewe bo hafi yawe
site.metaDescription: Fata abafasha bizewe bo hafi yawe mu isuku, gusana, ubwiza, kwita ku busitani, kwimuka, kwita ku matungo, kwita ku bakuze, kwigisha n'ibindi.
site.hero.body: Fata serivisi z'isuku, gusana, ubwiza, kwita ku busitani, kwimuka, kwita ku matungo n'izindi ahantu hamwe, mu isoko ryo mu gace utuyemo.
site.hero.rating: bivuye ku baturanyi 2,300+ · abafasha 1,200 bo hafi
site.hero.review: Nafashe umusanizi uri hafi aha mu minota 10.
site.hero.bookingMeta: Kwita ku busitani · Kuwa gatandatu 9:00 AM
site.how.title: Ubufasha buri ku makanda atatu
site.how.body: Kuva ku kuvuga uti nkeneye ko ibi bikorwa kugeza bifashwe, nta guhamagarana inshuro nyinshi, nta gukeka, nta biciro bidasobanutse.
site.steps.0.1: Reba abafasha bizewe ku ikarita nzima, bashyizwe uko bari hafi n'uko bafite amanota.
site.steps.1.1: Reba imyirondoro, serivisi n'ibiciro bigaragara mbere yo kwiyemeza.
site.steps.2.0: Wandikire, ubone ibarura ry'igiciro, ufate gahunda
site.steps.2.1: Andikirana, ubone ibarura ry'igiciro, ufate gahunda muri porogaramu. Ubwishyu bw'akazi bwumvikanwaho mu buryo butaziguye n'umufasha.
site.helpers.title: Hindura ubumenyi bwawe amafaranga yo mu gace utuyemo
site.helpers.body: Tegura rimwe maze utangire guhabwa gahunda n'abaturanyi bakeneye neza ibyo ukora.
site.helpers.freeTitle: Buri gihe ni ubuntu ku bafasha
site.helpers.freeBody: Komeza 100% by'ibyo winjiza. SwapSpot nta komisiyo, nta ijanisha, nta n'amafaranga yo kubona abakiriya yaka.
site.perks.0.1: Andika ubumenyi, amafoto n'agace ukoreramo mu minota mike.
site.perks.1.1: Ni wowe ugena ibiciro, intera na gahunda yawe.
site.perks.2.1: Akira ubusabe bwo hafi maze usubize ibarura ry'igiciro.
site.perks.3.1: Shaka amanota ahindura akazi ka mbere abakiriya b'igihe kirekire.
site.categories.title: Akazi kose, hari umufasha
site.categories.body: Ibyiciro by'ingenzi bya serivisi byo mu gace igihe dutangira, tukongeraho ibindi uko isoko ryose rikura.
site.trust.title: Yubatswe kugira ngo impande zombi zumve zifite umutekano
site.trust.body: Amasuzuma nyakuri, ubutumwa bw'ibanga, n'uburyo butuma abaturanyi bagenzura amakuru yabo.
site.trustItems.0.1: Amanota nyakuri y'abaturanyi nyakuri nyuma ya buri kazi.
site.trustItems.1.1: Gumana ibiganiro n'ibarura ry'igiciro ahantu hamwe.
site.trustItems.2.1: Tanga raporo cyangwa uhagarike umuntu igihe cyose.
site.trustItems.3.1: Siba konti yawe n'amakuru yawe igihe cyose ubishatse.
site.trustItems.4.1: Abafasha bagena uko aho bari herekanwa.
site.waitlist.title: Kuramo SwapSpot uyu munsi
site.waitlist.body: Reba abafasha bo hafi ku buntu. Koresha pasi igihe witeguye kwandikira, gusaba ibarura ry'igiciro cyangwa gufata gahunda.
site.waitlist.storeCaption: Iboneka ubu kuri iOS na Android
site.waitlist.noSpam: Kuramo porogaramu, urebe abafasha maze utangire igihe witeguye.
site.download.title: Kuramo SwapSpot kuri iOS cyangwa Android
site.download.body: Reba abafasha bo hafi ku buntu. Koresha pasi igihe witeguye kwandikira, gusaba ibarura ry'igiciro cyangwa gufata gahunda.
site.download.pointB: Kureba ku buntu mbere yo kuvugana n'umufasha
site.footer.tagline: Isoko ryo mu baturanyi ry'ubufasha bwizewe bwo hafi. Rikorera abaturage hirya no hino muri Amerika.
site.footer.bottom: Shaka ubufasha bwizewe bwo hafi yawe.
site.footer.companyLine: Ikorera munsi ya USPROJECT LLC · EIN 83-3989558 · New York, USA
directory.indexMetaDescription: Reba paji rusange za serivisi za SwapSpot ukurikije icyiciro n'isoko ryo mu gace. Shaka isuku, gusana, kwimuka, kwigisha, kwita ku matungo, ubwiza, serivisi z'umwuga n'ibindi.
directory.indexTitle: Serivisi z'abafasha bo hafi ukurikije icyiciro n'isoko
directory.indexIntro: Izi paji zikorwa hashingiwe kuri serivisi abafasha batangaje kuri SwapSpot. Zifasha abakiriya kubona ibigaragara bya serivisi nyakuri bakurikije umujyi, kode ya posita, agace, icyiciro, igiciro, ururimi n'amanota.
directory.byCountryBody: Buri murongo uri hepfo ufungura paji rusange. Iyo umufasha atangaje agace gashya akoreramo, kagaragara hano nyuma yo kuvugurura kopi y'urubuga.
directory.emptyBody: Urutonde rukorwa hashingiwe kuri serivisi abafasha batangaje. Niba nta murongo urahagaragara, ongera uhasure vuba cyangwa ufungure porogaramu urebe abafasha bo hafi yawe.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Shaka abafasha ba {categoryLower} muri {market}. Gereranya ibigaragara rusange bya serivisi, uduce bakoreramo, ibiciro, indimi n'amanota mbere yo gufungura SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Reba serivisi za {categoryLower} zo hafi ya {market} maze ukomereze muri porogaramu ya SwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot iri gutegura ibigaragara by'abafasha ba {categoryLower} muri {market}. Fungura porogaramu urebe abafasha bo hafi, ugereranye uduce bakoreramo kandi usabe ibarura ry'igiciro.
directory.pairSummary: Gereranya ibigaragara rusange bya serivisi za {categoryLower} z'abafasha bo hafi ya {market}. Koresha porogaramu igihe witeguye kwandikira, gusaba ibarura ry'igiciro cyangwa gufata gahunda.
directory.popularBody: Izi serivisi ziva ku mwirondoro w'abafasha batangaje, si urutonde rw'amamaza rudahinduka.
directory.areaBody: Paji rusange zigaragaza uduce, kode za posita, imijyi n'intera ya serivisi kugira ngo abakiriya babone ubufasha bwa hafi nta kugaragaza aderesi z'ibanga.
directory.namesBody: Serivisi z'abafasha zihurizwa ku mazina yoroshye gushakisha, amagambo y'ahantu na paji z'ibyiciro kugira ngo abakiriya bashakishe imirimo nyayo bakeneye.
directory.inAppTitle: Ikiganiro na gahunda biguma muri porogaramu
directory.inAppBody: Urubuga rufasha abantu kubona serivisi. SwapSpot ibika ibarura ry'igiciro, ubutumwa, gahunda, amasuzuma n'uburyo bw'umutekano muri porogaramu ya telefoni.
directory.pairFaq1Q: Nshobora gufata abafasha ba {categoryLower} muri {market} kuri iyi paji?
directory.pairFaq1A: Iyi paji y'urubuga ni uburyo rusange bwo kureba serivisi. Kuramo SwapSpot kugira ngo wandikire abafasha, usabe ibarura ry'igiciro, usangize aderesi nyayo kandi ucunge gahunda.
directory.pairFaq2A: Oya. SwapSpot yerekana uduce tugereranyije nka kode za posita, uduce, imijyi cyangwa intera. Aderesi nyayo ziguma ari ibanga kandi zisangizwa mu kiganiro gusa impande zombi zimaze kwitegura.
directory.pairFaq3A: Oya. Abafasha bashobora gukora umwirondoro bagashyiraho serivisi nta komisiyo cyangwa ijanisha bishyura SwapSpot. Abakiriya bishyura kugira ngo bakoreshe ubutumwa, basabe ibarura ry'igiciro cyangwa bafate gahunda.
directory.pairListDescription: Ibigaragara rusange bya serivisi za {categoryLower} ziboneka kuri SwapSpot muri {market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot iri gufungura imyirondoro y'abafasha bo hafi ukurikije isoko. Kuramo porogaramu urebe serivisi zo hafi, ugereranye ibiciro kandi wandikire abafasha igihe witeguye.
directory.cardsBody: Gereranya serivisi, ibiciro, uduce, indimi, amanota n'uburambe bw'abafasha bo hafi ya {market}. Aderesi nyayo n'itumanaho ritaziguye biguma muri SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Reba iyi serivisi muri SwapSpot, hanyuma ufungure porogaramu wandikire, usabe ibarura ry'igiciro cyangwa ufate gahunda.
directory.helperDescription: {name} atanga {services} kuri SwapSpot hafi ya {markets}. Gereranya ibigaragara rusange bya serivisi, ibiciro, indimi, amanota n'uduce akoreramo mbere yo gufungura porogaramu.
directory.helperDescriptionNoMarket: {name} atanga {services} kuri SwapSpot. Gereranya ibigaragara rusange bya serivisi, ibiciro, indimi, amanota n'uduce akoreramo mbere yo gufungura porogaramu.
directory.previewBody: Gereranya serivisi hano, hanyuma wandikire kandi ufate gahunda muri porogaramu.
directory.noCommissionBody: Abafasha bagumana ubwishyu bw'imirimo. SwapSpot nta ijanisha cyangwa komisiyo ifata ku kazi k'abafasha.
directory.servicesBody: Ibi ni ibigaragara bya serivisi byatangajwe kuri SwapSpot. Ibiciro bishobora kuba bihamye, ku isaha, guhera ku giciro runaka cyangwa gutangwa ubisabye bitewe n'akazi.
directory.serviceFallback: Fungura SwapSpot urebe iyi serivisi, usabe ibisobanuro kandi wemeze ibizakorwa mbere yo gufata gahunda.
directory.areasBody: Paji rusange z'abafasha zihesha moteri zishakisha n'abakiriya amakuru ahagije: amazina ya serivisi, uduce, imijyi, uduce tugereranyije n'ibimenyetso by'indimi. Amakuru y'itumanaho nyayo aguma muri SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Andikira, usabe ibarura ry'igiciro kandi ufate gahunda ufite uburyo bw'ibanga.
directory.helperFaq1A: Fungura SwapSpot wandikire umufasha, usabe ibarura ry'igiciro, usangize ibisobanuro nyabyo by'akazi kandi ucunge gahunda mu mutekano muri porogaramu.
directory.helperFaq2A: Oya. Paji rusange zigaragaza uduce tugereranyije nk'uduce, imijyi, kode za posita cyangwa intera. Aderesi nyayo ziguma ari ibanga kugeza abakoresha bazisangije mu kiganiro.
directory.helperFaq3A: Oya. Abafasha bashobora gushyiraho serivisi nta komisiyo cyangwa ijanisha SwapSpot ifata ku bwishyu bw'akazi kabo.
directory.categoryMetaTitle: {category} hafi yawe - Abafasha bizewe bo hafi
directory.categoryMetaDescription: Fata abafasha bizewe ba {categoryLower} bo hafi yawe kuri SwapSpot. Gereranya imyirondoro, ibiciro n'amasuzuma.
directory.categoryBody: Shakisha serivisi za {categoryLower} z'abafasha bo mu gace kawe.
directory.cityMetaDescription: Shaka abafasha bizewe bo muri {city} mu isuku, gusana, kwita ku busitani, kwita ku matungo n'ibindi.
directory.cityBody: Fata abafasha bo hafi mu isuku, gusana, kwita ku busitani, kwimuka, kwita ku matungo, kwita ku bakuze, kwigisha n'ibindi. SwapSpot ifasha abaturanyi kugereranya serivisi, ibiciro, amasuzuma n'igihe babonekera mbere yo gufata gahunda.
directory.cityCategoryBody: Gereranya abafasha bizewe bo hafi yawe
directory.helpersMetaTitle: Iyandikishe nk'umufasha - Shaka amafaranga mu gace
directory.helpersMetaDescription: Hindura ubumenyi bwawe amafaranga yo mu gace kuri SwapSpot. Kora umwirondoro w'umufasha ku buntu, shyiraho ibiciro n'igihe uboneka, maze ufatwe n'abakiriya bo hafi.
pricing.title: Reba ku buntu. Koresha pasi igihe witeguye gukora.
pricing.body: Abakiriya bashobora gushakisha ibyiciro no kugereranya abafasha batishyuye. Pasi irakenewe kugira ngo wandikire, usabe ibarura ry'igiciro cyangwa ufate umufasha. Ubwishyu bw'akazi ubwabwo bwumvikanwaho mu buryo butaziguye n'umufasha.
pricing.freeBody: Reba ibyiciro, ibigaragara by'abafasha, uduce bakoreramo n'ibimenyetso by'ibanze by'icyizere mbere yo guhitamo pasi.
pricing.plans.0.name: Pasi y'umunsi
pricing.plans.0.note: Ikwiye akazi kamwe, ubufasha bwihutirwa cyangwa kugerageza SwapSpot.
pricing.plans.1.name: Client Pro
pricing.plans.1.note: Ikwiye ibikenewe bisanzwe byo mu rugo, mu muryango, mu nzu zikodeshwa cyangwa mu bucuruzi.
pricing.plans.1.features.1: Andikira kandi usabe ibarura ry'igiciro igihe cyose
passPrice.seeStore: Reba igiciro cy'ubu muri App Store cyangwa Google Play
passPrice.referenceNote: Igiciro cy'ibigereranyo. App Store cyangwa Google Play herekana igiciro cya nyuma.
passPrice.footnote: Igiciro cya nyuma cyo mu gace n'imisoro bigaragazwa na App Store cyangwa Google Play mbere yo kugura.
staticPages.intro: Iyi paji iboneka mu rurimi wahisemo. Ku bibazo by'amategeko cyangwa bijyanye na konti, twandikire kuri hello@swapspot.org.
appPreview.title: Gahunda yose, uhereye ku itangiriro kugeza irangiye
appPreview.messageA: Muraho! Mwakora isuku y'inzu y'ibyumba 2 kuwa gatandatu?
forClients.title: Rangiza akazi nta kwirukanka ku bantu
forClients.body: Fungura porogaramu, urebe uri hafi, ugereranye imyirondoro nyakuri, wandikire muri SwapSpot kandi ufate gahunda igihe wumva ari byiza.
forClients.cards.0.1: Shakisha ukurikije icyiciro, intera, amanota n'igihe babonekera.
forClients.cards.1.1: Reba imyirondoro, ibiciro, amasuzuma, amafoto na serivisi.
forClients.cards.2.1: Baza ibibazo, wemeze ibisobanuro kandi ubike ibarura ry'igiciro neza.
forClients.cards.3.1: Koresha amasuzuma, raporo, guhagarika abantu n'uburyo bwo kugenzura konti igihe bikenewe.
cookieConsent.title: Amahitamo yawe ku banga
cookieConsent.body: Dukoresha cookies za Google Analytics kugira ngo twumve abasura kandi tunoze SwapSpot. Ushobora kwemera cyangwa kwanga cookies z'isesengura zitari ngombwa.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot iri kwimurirwa kuri seriveri nshya. Mu gihe cy'isaha igera, kwinjira, guhindura ijambobanga n'impinduka kuri konti bishobora kutakora. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.
reset.title: Hindura ijambobanga ryawe
reset.intro: Hitamo ijambobanga rishya, hanyuma winjire muri porogaramu ya SwapSpot ukoresheje imeri yawe n'ijambobanga rishya.
reset.done: Ijambobanga ryawe ryahinduwe. Fungura porogaramu ya SwapSpot maze winjire.
reset.invalid: Uyu murongo wo guhindura ijambobanga ntiwemewe cyangwa warangiye. Saba undi muri porogaramu.
reset.openLink: Fungura umurongo wakiriye kuri imeri yawe kugira ngo ukomeze.
reset.unavailable: Guhindura ijambobanga ntibiraboneka kuri uru rubuga.
